name.value: The Golden Horn Turkish Bakery & Cafe

description.value: The Golden Horn is a halal-certified Turkish bakery and cafe on Vancouver's Cambie corridor, specializing in handcrafted pastries including baklava made in-house from over 40 layers of homemade yufka dough, plus boreks, pide flatbreads, and traditional Turkish coffee. The Cambie location is described as a comfortable space to relax, socialize, or study, and also offers heartier dishes like iskender platters and wraps (durums) that can make for a substantial mid-ride meal. The business operates a second location at Canada Place on the seawall, which offers harbour and mountain views.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 39m; stands (4 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 12 spaces.

No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM records only the Cambie Street location; the business also operates a second location at 40-1055 Canada Place (Vancouver Convention Centre/Canada Place seawall) with a separate phone number (604-647-7550). That location may warrant its own OSM/directory record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and a current online menu. Good refuelling option for cyclists on the Cambie corridor.
